name: Laria
description: An Argivian leader who meets Farid's party in the downed thopter, trades goods, and learns of the planned attack.

description_citations.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
description_citations.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Four Argivians led by Laria arrive, and the two groups share spirits and goods, Aiman and Laria speaking Argivian.
timeline.quote: Four Argivians clambered into the wreck of the bomber.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Farid betrays the Fallaji attack plan, telling Laria about the transmogrants, replacements and extra rations.
timeline.quote: Our generals have moved in a whole regiment of transmogrants

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Laria tells Aiman that Tawnos has brought a dozen units of Clay Soldiers, so the Argivians know the attack is coming.
timeline.quote: Laria said they know our attack is coming.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Karrak finds a packet containing chocolate and a note of gratitude from the Argivians, and the front moves on.
timeline.quote: revealing a small piece of chocolate and a note.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

relations.note: Farid trades with and warns Laria.
